| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Low threshold** `low` | 50 | 0 to 255 | Pixels at or above this value are weak. They are kept only when joined to a strong pixel. |
| **High threshold** `high` | 100 | 0 to 255 | Pixels at or above this value are strong and always kept. If it is below the low threshold, the low threshold is used. |
| **Neighbors** `connectivity` | 8 neighbors (diagonals join) | 8 neighbors (diagonals join), 4 neighbors | Which pixels count as joined. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Clip to 0 to 255 | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
